steps.name: injectFile
steps.script: var modelJson = { dslVersion: '1.0.0', namespace: 'sample', version: '1.0.0', concepts: [ { name: 'Author', fields: [ { name: 'id', type: 'uuid', id: true, required: true }, { name: 'name', type: 'string', required: true } ] }, { name: 'Book', fields: [ { name: 'id', type: 'uuid', id: true, required: true }, { name: 'title', type: 'string', required: true }, { name: 'authorId', type: 'reference', required: true, reference: { target: 'Author', onDelete: 'restrict' } } ] } ] }; var file = new File([JSON.stringify(modelJson)], 'model.json', { type: 'application/json' }); var dt = new DataTransfer(); dt.items.add(file); var openBtn = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(function (b) { return b.textContent.trim() === 'Open model only'; }); var section = openBtn ? openBtn.closest('section') : null; var input = section ? section.querySelector('input[type="file"]') : null; if (input) { input.files = dt.files; input.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); } return { foundButton: !!openBtn, foundInput: !!input };
steps.label: Inject a minimal valid model.json into the file input via DataTransfer, same as a real file pick
